AWS is part of 5 of my public repositories, from 2014 to 2018.

What it was for: [Systems and infrastructure](@/projects/systems.md) (3) and [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (2).

Most recently: [aws-lambda-docker](@/work/aws-lambda-docker.md): Example how to run Docker image using AWS Lambda; [cluster](@/work/cluster.md): Run your own CoreOS/Kubernetes cluster; [magicbiz](@/work/magicbiz.md): A Decentralized Autonomous Organization Proof of Concept.

1 of these projects runs as a live site.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses AWS: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links AWS to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
